description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。

latest_release.name: v0.6.6
latest_release.body:
# S2Arm v0.6.6

这是 0.6.5 的修复版：修复 iPhone 上游戏声音反复断开；「导出…」导出通用 S2Arm 到文件夹时一并放上本版 S2Arm.ipa；修复 Mac 切到后台后帧率补丁被误关；修复 iOS 诊断包里中文日志变成乱码；检测更新不再收起正在填的 Apple ID 登录。
*A fix release for 0.6.5: it fixes game audio repeatedly cutting out on iPhone; "Export…" to a folder for the universal S2Arm now includes this version's S2Arm.ipa; it also fixes frame-rate patches being switched off after the Mac window goes to the background, fixes Chinese logs in iOS diagnostics turning into garbled text, and checking for updates no longer closes an Apple ID sign-in you are filling in.*

## 修复
- **修复 iPhone 上游戏声音反复断开（#1921）**：iPhone 上声音正常按时播放时，S2Arm 有时会误判声音跑在了前面而重启音频，每重启一次就断一下音，严重时几十秒里断十几次。现在先核对音频的实际播放进度，只有真跑在前面时才重启，正常播放不再断音。
  *Fixed game audio repeatedly cutting out on iPhone (#1921). When audio was playing on time, S2Arm sometimes mistook it for running ahead and restarted the audio, and every restart was a short dropout — in bad cases a dozen or more within tens of seconds. S2Arm now checks the actual playback position first and only restarts when audio really is ahead, so normal playback no longer cuts out.*
- **「导出…」导出通用 S2Arm 到文件夹时一并放上 S2Arm.ipa（#502）**：游戏页「导出…」选通用 S2Arm、一台设备都不勾时，文件夹里除了这款的游戏包，还会放上本版 S2Arm.ipa。LiveContainer、SideStore、AltStore 等自签、没连过电脑的玩家，用它签好装上就能用到新版修复。发布页也附了同一份未签名 S2Arm.ipa。
  *"Export…" to a folder for the universal S2Arm now includes S2Arm.ipa (#502). When you choose the universal S2Arm in "Export…" on the game page and tick no devices, the folder now holds this version's S2Arm.ipa alongside the game package. Players who self-sign with LiveContainer, SideStore, AltStore and so on, and have never connected a computer, can sign and install it to get the latest fixes. The same unsigned S2Arm.ipa is also attached to the release page.*
- **修复 Mac 切到后台后帧率补丁被误关（#1857）**：Mac 上游戏窗口切到后台、又没开「切到别的窗口时暂停」时，后台本来就不出画面，原先会被当成帧率补丁卡住画面而把补丁关掉，下次进游戏也关着。现在后台和睡眠的时间不算，补丁不再被误关。
  *Fixed frame-rate patches being switched off after the Mac window goes to the background (#1857). With the game window in the background and "Pause when switching to another window" off, no frames are drawn anyway, but this was taken as the frame-rate patch freezing the picture, so the patch was switched off — and stayed off next time. Time in the background or asleep no longer counts, so the patch is no longer switched off by mistake.*
- **修复 iOS 诊断包里中文日志变成乱码**：日志里只要有一处被截断的汉字，整份中文日志在诊断包里就变成乱码。现在只把那一处坏的字节替换掉，其余照常可读；之前版本发来的乱码诊断也能还原。
  *Fixed Chinese logs in iOS diagnostics turning into garbled text. A single cut-off character anywhere in a log used to turn the whole log into garbled text in the diagnostic package. Now only the broken bytes are replaced and the rest stays readable; garbled diagnostics sent from earlier versions can be restored too.*
- **检测更新不再收起正在填的 Apple ID 登录**：在设置里点「检测更新」后去登录 Apple ID，更新结果回来时会把设置页和登录面板一起收起，填到一半的账号密码就没了。现在不会再收起。
  *Checking for updates no longer closes an Apple ID sign-in you are filling in. If you clicked "Check for Updates" in Settings and then started signing in to your Apple ID, the result coming back closed Settings together with the sign-in panel and lost what you had typed. It no longer does.*
- **Mac 程序坞图标换成游戏封面（#994）**：Mac 上开局后，程序坞里的图标显示这款游戏的封面；更新说明按界面语言显示。
  *The Mac Dock icon now shows the game cover (#994). After a game starts on Mac, its Dock icon shows the game's cover art; update notes now show in the interface language.*
- **Windows 修正**：静默安装时不再弹出空黑窗（#1919）；出包时自带工具被 Windows 拦下、读不到着色器编译器版本时，提示说清是被拦下、没装还是起不来（#1912）。
  *Windows fixes: silent installs no longer pop up an empty black window (#1919); when Windows blocks the bundled tools during a build or the shader compiler version cannot be read, the message now says whether it was blocked, not installed or failed to start (#1912).*
- **iPhone 窄屏上提示条的按钮不再挤在一起**。
  *Buttons on the prompt bar no longer get squeezed on narrow iPhone screens.*

## 系统要求
- 与 0.6.5 相同：Mac 需要 Apple 芯片、macOS 15 或更新；Windows 需要 64 位 Windows 10 或 11；iPhone / iPad 需要 iOS / iPadOS 18 或更新。
  *Same as 0.6.5: Mac wit

detail.readme:
s2arm.com

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [English](README.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)

> [!NOTE] > **[s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) is the official S2Arm website.** S2Arm is free and open source and never accepts donations; get S2Arm only from [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) or this GitHub repository. **Your own Switch games, running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac.** Game code is rewritten to native ARM64 and runs directly on the device's processor, with graphics going straight to Metal. From 0.6.0 there is a single S2Arm app on your phone and every game lives in its library: in the Mac or Windows launcher, send games to your iPhone one by one and play. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 and later) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later) · Mac or Windows launcher · License: Apache-2.0 · **Bring your own games** [Download the launcher](https://s2arm.com) · [All releases](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md)

## What's new in 0.6.0 ### One app for all your games Install S2Arm on your phone once, then add games one by one. Updating or renewing S2Arm never means installing your games again, and your saves stay. Sign with a free or paid Apple ID or a developer certificate, or sign it yourself and import it. ### Snapshots: save this moment, come back any time No need to wait for the game's own save point. In a game, tap the ◉ in the top-right corner to save the moment you're in; press and hold it and choose Go back to the saved moment to return. Next time, Continue from this moment at the top of the library takes you straight there. - Each game keeps only the latest snapshot; a new one replaces the old. - A snapshot takes storage on your phone (the size depends on the game). Press and hold to delete it and free the space, or turn snapshots off in Settings. - A snapshot only works on the device that saved it, and still works after you update S2Arm.

### One file, any of your devices Export any game as a .s2arm file and import it on another of your devices to play; the phone signs it by itself. Each game keeps one copy of its files, and Free up space shows what games, saves and snapshots take. ### Every shader, ready from the first play Shaders the game needs are prepared when you send it, so new areas no longer stutter the first time. Player diagnostics collected **26,809** shaders from 69 games that failed to compile on the device. Leaving out 278 damaged inputs that can't be read as shaders, **all 26,531** of the rest now compile. How it is counted: the rate covers only shaders that **had failed to compile** in player diagnostics; it is not a coverage rate for all shaders. Of the remaining 98, 91 were not shaders at all but memory read wrongly during capture (capture fixed), and the other 7 have been fixed at the root. Note: on iPhone, precompiled pipelines are generated only when you Push to iPhone with that iPhone connected. When exporting for self-signing (no iPhone connected) or with several iPhones connected, this version still compiles them the first time they are needed, as in 0.5. This will improve in a later version. ### Fixes, performance and graphics From 0.5.0 to 0.6.0 (how each number is counted is in the table): | | Number | How it's counted | |---|---|---| | Fixes merged | **344** | Fix commits merged into main after 0.5.0 | | Player reports handled | **156** | Feedback issues closed after 0.5.0 | | Community contributions | **126** | Pull requests from players and developers | | GPU render time | **−50%** | Deferred-lighting scene, 4.8–5.9 ms → 2.7 ms | | Build memory peak | **−35%** | Peak memory while building large games | Also: several kinds of shader problems fixed at the root, more reliable loading and saving, smoother frame generation, and steadier app install, signing and sending on Windows and Mac. Thank you to every player who reported a problem. ## Getting started 1. Download the Mac or Windows launcher from [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) and open it. 2. Import your own keys and games; put the base game, updates and DLC in one folder and import them together. 3. Connect your iPhone, click Install S2Arm on the S2Arm tile, first in the launcher's game library, sign in and sign with your Apple ID, and S2Arm goes onto your phone. 4. Pick a game and click Push to iPhone. 5. Open S2Arm on your phone and pick a game in the library. You can also play on the Mac itself: choose This Mac. Without a cable, export a .s2arm file and put it on your phone with AirDrop or the Files app. ### Self-signing with AltStore / SideStore Import games right on your phone, with no Apple ID sign-in on a computer and no new certificate: 1. In AltStore or SideStore settings, export your signing certificate and set a password. 2. Open S2Arm: gear → Signing certificate → Import .p12…, pick the certificate and enter the password. 3. Then put .s2arm and .img files (exported from your computer or shared by a friend) into S2Arm's Import Here folder, and play. Note: manage each Apple ID from AltServer on only one computer. Using two makes them revoke each other's certificates, and AltStore shows "Multiple AltServers". Before the 7 days run out, just tap Refresh All in AltStore; nothing else to do in S2Arm. ### Upgrading from 0.5 The games, saves and game data already on your phone all stay. No exporting again, no sending game data again. 1. On a Mac, sign in with your Apple ID once in S2Arm (0.5 used the account signed in to Xcode; 0.6.0 signs in inside S2Arm. Windows players skip this step). 2. Connect your phone and click Update S2Arm on the S2Arm tile, first in the game library. Your saves are backed up to the computer first, then the new app goes on over the old one (same Apple ID). 3. Right after that, the same page says how many old games on this phone need one update before they play; they are all checked, so click Update these N games (or later, check the games marked Update suggested in the dashboard and click Update selected). One game at a time, it brings the saves back to the computer, pushes the new program and sends only the resources that changed; each game takes about 1–2 minutes. For games whose shader library was built by the old version, the computer rebuilds it with the new one in this step (the game's files or its Mac version must still be in your library); the first time takes from a few minutes to a few tens of minutes. You don't need S-grade optimization for this. On a Windows PC without the Metal developer tools, this step sends the old library and says why; the game still plays, and once you install them under Get this PC ready, push again to get the new library. Until step 3 is done those games show Update once on your computer on the phone and won't open, but they aren't gone. Games installed from another computer are listed on a separate line on the same page; update them on that computer. If you used Free up space to delete a game's iPhone resource pack, build that game's iPhone package again. If you sign the app yourself with AltStore or similar: connect the phone, click Install S2Arm on the S2Arm card first in the game library, and on the page saying you aren't signed in with an Apple ID, click Export for self-signing instead (no iPhone needed) to get the new S2Arm.ipa; install it over the old one with AltStore; import your signing certificate (SideStore: gear → Signing certificate → Get from SideStore in S2Arm; AltStore: export it in AltStore settings, then Import .p12…); finally click Send selected to iPhone in the console, or click Export for self-signing on each game and put its .s2arm and .img into Import Here. ## Let an AI drive Both the Mac and Windows launchers expose a control interface, `s2armctl`. An AI assistant can import games, build, install, follow progress and read errors, and every step shows up in the launcher window. A companion self-check, self-fix and feedback toolkit lets the AI find a problem, apply the documented fix, and, when it cannot, package a diagnostic bundle for you to file. Watch an AI diagnose and fix a real problem end to end: [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#ai-at-the-wheel) ### Have an AI do it for you Send this to your AI assistant (it needs to be able to run commands on your computer): > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md and then help me install my Switch game on my iPhone. It moves forward with a few commands, and you can watch every step in the launcher window: ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # open and connect to the launcher /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # what to do now, who does it, and why /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-diagnostics.zip # export a diagnostic bundle if it cannot fix a problem ``` Anything only you can do (system permission prompts, signing in with your Apple ID, tapping Trust on your phone), the AI stops and asks you to do. On Windows, use `s2armctl.cmd` in the launcher folder with the same commands. Windows builds iPhone / iPad packages only, so report problems inside a game from the phone: tap the report button to the right of the gear at the top left in game and say which game, what you did and what you saw. The diagnostic bundle is uploaded with it. **Something wrong inside a game** (graphics, frame rate, stutter, crashes)? Send your AI: > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/skills/player-game-triage/SKILL.md . My S2Arm game has this problem: . Check the settings first, then collect diagnostics; if you can change code, fix it at the root and open a PR, otherwise help me file an issue. ## Tested at scale **211** games surveyed with a **95%** first-try build success rate. **4,700+** test runs on real iOS devices and **1,000+** on macOS. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#tested-at-scale) ## Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery On a 16 GB MacBook Air (M3), from importing a game to a finished iPhone build, completely cold: | Game | Game files | Shaders | Build time | |---|---|---|---| | A 23.5 GB action RPG | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 min** | | A 12.0 GB life-sim game | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 min** | | A 17.5 GB open-world game | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 min** | A Switch 2 game, measured on an iPhone 17 Pro Max: a **full 60 fps** while the phone is cool, **37–43 fps** once sustained load has heated it up, at about **0.15 J per frame**. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#speed-and-efficiency) ## Platforms | Platform | Support | |---|---| | iPhone / iPad | iOS / iPadOS 18 and later; every game in one S2Arm app | | Mac | Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later; the launcher installs the app and sends games, and you can also play on the Mac | | Windows | Graphical launcher: install the app, send games, export .s2arm | [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#platforms) ## Downstream deep ports Some games have a deep port made specially by the community. S2Arm recognizes these games: on export it shows a page explaining the option, and you can switch to the downstream project's route (importing, packing and installing are still buttons in S2Arm, with the downstream project's implementation underneath) or keep the standard route. The registry is [`pack/downstream/schemes.json`](pack/downstream/schemes.json); the contract between the two is the downstream project's document. | Route | Project | Devices | Contract | |---|---|---|---| | D2R-Mobile | [jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) | iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; Android and HarmonyOS in progress) | [docs/S2ARM.md](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/blob/main/docs/S2ARM.md) | ## Honest boundaries S2Arm runs 64-bit (AArch64) games. Apple silicon cannot execute 32-bit ARM code, so 32-bit games are outside what S2Arm supports, as are games that need a 36-bit address space. ## Development [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [AI collaboration policy](LLM_POLICY.md) · [Diagnosis and root-fix skills for AI](skills/) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/issues) · [Third-party licenses](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md) ## Thanks S2Arm stands on the shoulders of its community. - **Co-developers**: thank you to everyone who has opened a pull request or issue in this project. s2arm.com

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [English](README.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)

> [!NOTE] > **[s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) 是 S2Arm 的官方网站。** S2Arm 免费开源，从不接受任何捐赠；请只从 [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) 或本 GitHub 仓库获取 S2Arm。 **把你自己的 Switch 游戏，原生带到 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。** 游戏代码改写成原生 ARM64，直接在设备的处理器上执行；图形直连 Metal。0.6.0 起，手机上只装一个 S2Arm App，所有游戏都在它的游戏库里；在 Mac 或 Windows 的启动器里把游戏一款一款「推到 iPhone」就能玩。 平台：iPhone / iPad（iOS / iPadOS 18 起）· Mac（Apple 芯片，macOS 15 起）· Mac 或 Windows 启动器 · 许可：Apache-2.0 · **游戏原件自备** [下载启动器](https://s2arm.com) · [全部版本](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [证据页](docs/validation/证据.md)

## 0.6.0 有什么新东西 ### 一个 App，装下所有游戏 手机上只装一次 S2Arm，以后游戏一款一款推进去。S2Arm 更新、续签，都不用把游戏重装一遍，存档也都在。签名可以用免费或付费的 Apple ID、开发者证书，也可以自己签名后导入。 ### 即时快照：存下这一刻，随时回来 不用等游戏自己的存档点。游戏里轻点右上角的 ◉，当下这一刻就被存下来；长按它，选「回到上次存下的这一刻」就回去。下次打开游戏库，最上面的「从这一刻继续」点一下直接进。 - 每款游戏只留最新的一份，新存的会盖掉旧的。 - 一份快照会占用手机空间（大小因游戏而异），长按就能删除、腾出空间；设置里也能关掉。 - 快照只在存下它的那台设备上能用；S2Arm 更新之后照样能回去。

### 一个文件，换台设备接着玩 每款游戏可以导出成 .s2arm 文件，放到你的另一台设备上导入就能玩，手机会自己完成签名。一款游戏只占一份空间，游戏、存档、快照各占多少，在「释放空间」里一目了然。 ### 着色器全覆盖：第一次玩就流畅 推游戏时就把游戏要用的着色器备好，第一次进新场景不再卡一下。玩家诊断里收集到 69 款游戏在设备上现编失败的着色器共 **26,809** 个：除去 278 个本身已损坏、读不成着色器的输入，其余 **26,531** 个现在**全部**能编出。 口径：这个比例只算玩家诊断里**历史上编译失败过的**着色器，不是全部着色器的覆盖率。剩下的 98 个里，91 个是抓取时读错了内存、本来就不是着色器（抓取已修），另外 7 个已根修。 注意：iPhone 上的预编管线要在电脑连着这台 iPhone「推到 iPhone」时才会生成；导出自签包（不连手机）或同时连着多台 iPhone 时，这一版仍是第一次遇到时现编，和 0.5 一样，后续版本会改进。 ### 修复、性能和画面 从 0.5.0 到 0.6.0（口径见下）： | | 数字 | 口径 | |---|---|---| | 修复合入 | **344** 项 | 0.5.0 发布后合入 main 的修复提交 | | 玩家反馈处理 | **156** 条 | 0.5.0 发布后关闭的反馈帖 | | 社区贡献合入 | **126** 份 | 来自玩家与开发者的 PR | | GPU 渲染耗时 | **−50%** | 延迟光照场景，4.8–5.9 ms → 2.7 ms | | 出包内存峰值 | **−35%** | 大型游戏出包时的内存峰值 | 另外还有：多类着色器问题根修、读档存档更可靠、补帧更顺，Windows 和 Mac 上装 App、签名、推送更稳。感谢每一位反馈问题的玩家。 ## 开始使用 1. 从 [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) 下载 Mac 或 Windows 启动器，打开即用。 2. 导入你自己的密钥和游戏；本体、更新和 DLC 放在同一个文件夹里一次导入。 3. 连上 iPhone，在启动器游戏库第一格的「S2Arm」里点「安装 S2Arm」，用你的 Apple ID 登录、签名，把 S2Arm 装到手机上。 4. 选一款游戏，点「推到 iPhone」。 5. 在手机上打开 S2Arm，在游戏库里选游戏开玩。 在 Mac 上也能直接玩：选「这台 Mac」即可。不连手机的话，可以导出 .s2arm 文件，用 AirDrop 或「文件」App 放到手机上导入。 ### 用 AltStore / SideStore 自签 不用电脑登录 Apple ID、也不用新建证书，手机上就能导入游戏： 1. 在 AltStore 或 SideStore 的设置里「导出签名证书」，设一个密码。 2. 打开 S2Arm：齿轮 →「签名证书」→「导入 .p12…」，选这份证书，输入密码。 3. 之后把电脑导出的或朋友分享的 .s2arm 和 .img 放进 S2Arm 的「放这里导入」，就能玩。 注意：同一个 Apple ID 只在一台电脑的 AltServer 上管理；两台电脑都用会互相作废证书，AltStore 会弹「Multiple AltServers」。7 天到期前在 AltStore 点「Refresh All」即可，S2Arm 里不用再做什么。 ### 从 0.5 升级 你手机上原来的游戏、存档和游戏数据都会留着，不用重新出包，也不用重传游戏数据。 1. Mac 玩家先在 S2Arm 里用 Apple ID 登录一次（0.5 用的是 Xcode 里的账号，0.6.0 改成直接在 S2Arm 里登录；Windows 玩家不用多做这一步）。 2. 连上手机，在游戏库第一格的「S2Arm」里点「更新 S2Arm」：会先把各款存档备份到电脑，再换成新 App。用同一个 Apple ID 就是覆盖安装。 3. 装完后同一页会提示「这台手机上有 N 款旧游戏，要更新一次才能玩」，默认全勾，点「更新这 N 款」（之后也可以在总控台勾上标着「建议更新」的游戏，点「更新所选」）：每款依次把存档拉回电脑、推上新版程序，资源只补变了的，每款约 1–2 分钟。着色器库还是旧版做的游戏，电脑会在这一步按新版重做（要游戏库里还有这款的游戏文件或 Mac 版），第一次要几分钟到几十分钟。不用点 S 级优化。Windows 电脑没装 Metal 开发工具时，这一步照推旧库并写明原因，游戏照样能玩；在「准备这台电脑」里装好后再推一次就换上新库。 第 3 步做完之前，这些游戏在手机上会显示「在电脑上更新一次」，点不进去，但没丢。别的电脑装的游戏，同一页会另起一行列出，到装它们的那台电脑上更新。用「释放空间」删过 iPhone 资源包的游戏，要重新打这款的 iPhone 包。 用 AltStore 等自己签名的玩家：连上手机，在游戏库第一格「S2Arm」里点「安装 S2Arm」，在提示还没登录 Apple ID 的那一页点「改为导出自签包（不用连手机）」，得到新版 S2Arm.ipa，用 AltStore 装上覆盖旧的；再导入签名证书（SideStore 在 S2Arm 齿轮 →「签名证书」里点「从 SideStore 获取」；AltStore 在它的设置里导出证书后点「导入 .p12…」）；最后在总控台点「推所选到 iPhone」，或对每款点「导出自签包」，把 .s2arm 和 .img 放进「放这里导入」。 ## AI 可以直接驾驶 Mac 和 Windows 启动器都开放了控制接口 `s2armctl`：AI 助手可以导入游戏、出包、装机、查进度、读错误，每一步都在启动器窗口里看得见。配套的自查、自修与反馈工具包让 AI 自己定位问题、按处方修复，修不好就整理出诊断包交给你提交。看 AI 诊断并修好一个真实问题的完整实录：[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#ai-驾驶) ### 让 AI 帮你操作 把这句话发给你的 AI 助手（需要它能在你的电脑上执行命令）： > 请阅读 https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md ，然后帮我把我的 Switch 游戏装到 iPhone 上。 它会用这几条命令一步步推进，你在启动器窗口里看得到每一步： ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # 打开并连上启动器 /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # 现在该做什么、谁来做、为什么 /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-诊断.zip # 修不好时导出诊断包 ``` 需要你本人做的事（系统授权、登录 Apple ID、在手机上点「信任」），AI 会停下来告诉你。Windows 上用启动器文件夹里的 `s2armctl.cmd`，命令相同。Windows 只出 iPhone / iPad 包，游戏里的问题请在手机上报：点游戏里左上角齿轮右边的报修按钮，写清哪款游戏、做了什么、看到了什么，诊断包会一起传上来。 **游戏里出了问题**（画面、帧率、卡顿、闪退）？把这句话发给 AI： > 请阅读 https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/skills/player-game-triage/SKILL.md 。我在 S2Arm 里玩的游戏出了这个问题：<描述现象>。先帮我查设置、收诊断；你能改代码就按里面的方法根修并提 PR，修不了就帮我整理成 Issue。 ## 经过大规模真机检验 **211** 款游戏完成普查，一次出包成功率 **95%**。**4700+** 局 iOS 真机测试，**1000+** 局 macOS 测试。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#大规模真机检验) ## 快、顺、省电 在一台 16 GB 内存的 MacBook Air（M3）上，从导入游戏到出好 iPhone 包，全程冷启动： | 游戏 | 原件 | 着色器 | 出包用时 | |---|---|---|---| | 一款 23.5 GB 的动作角色扮演游戏 | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 分钟** | | 一款 12.0 GB 的生活模拟游戏 | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 分钟** | | 一款 17.5 GB 的开放世界游戏 | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 分钟** | 一款 Switch 2 游戏在 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上真机实测，手机未发热时**满 60 帧**，持续高负载发热后 **37～43 帧**，每帧耗电约 **0.15 焦耳**。[证据](docs/validation/证据.md#速度与能效) ## 覆盖面 | 平台 | 支持 | |---|---| | iPhone / iPad | iOS / iPadOS 18 起；一个 S2Arm App 里装所有游戏 | | Mac | Apple 芯片，macOS 15 起；启动器装 App、推游戏，也能直接在 Mac 上玩 | | Windows | 图形启动器：装 App、推游戏、导出 .s2arm | [证据](docs/validation/证据.md#平台与系统) ## 下游深度方案 有的游戏有社区专门做的深度移植。S2Arm 认得出这些游戏：导出时弹一页说明，你可以改用下游项目的方案（导入、出包、装机仍在 S2Arm 里点按钮完成，底层换成下游项目的实现），也可以照常用原版方案。登记表在 [`pack/downstream/schemes.json`](pack/downstream/schemes.json)，两边的约定以下游项目的说明为准。 | 方案 | 项目 | 终端 | 约定 | |---|---|---|---| | D2R-Mobile | [jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) | iPhone / iPad（iOS 26 起；安卓、鸿蒙接入中） | [docs/S2ARM.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/blob/main/docs/S2ARM.zh-CN.md) | ## 诚实的边界 S2Arm 运行 64 位（AArch64）游戏。Apple 芯片不能执行 32 位 ARM 代码，所以 32 位游戏不在支持范围内；需要 36 位地址空间的游戏同样不在支持范围内。
